tool_signatures.name: plan_creative_video
tool_signatures.description: Turn a brief into a plan-aware storyboard, style/layout direction, scene recipes and anti-repetition rules BEFORE authoring JSON — plus libraryCandidates: concrete published examples ranked against the brief with an adapt-vs-assemble decision. Modes: consistent reuses a stable seed; fresh produces a new direction; explore returns 2-5 materially different directions.
